This Programme, implemented by the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR), will help the MSS/GSF achieve its objectives by i) building the capacity of mission personnel to prevent, identify, investigate, report, and act on human rights violations, gender-based violence, and sexual exploitation and abuse; ii) advancing human rights protection of Haitian local communities and civil society; and iii) strengthening the capacity of Haitian rule of law entities collaborating with the MSS/GSF, such as the police, judiciary and prison administration, to conduct operations in accordance with international human rights standards.</narrative></description><participating-org ref="GB-GOV-1" type="10" role="1"><narrative>Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)</narrative></participating-org><participating-org ref="GB-GOV-1" type="10" role="2"><narrative>Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)</narrative></participating-org><participating-org ref="162426" role="4"><narrative>OFFICE OF THE HIGH COMMISSIONER FOR HUMAN RIGHTS OHCHR</narrative></participating-org><activity-status code="2" /><activity-date type="1" iso-date="2024-12-03" /><activity-date type="2" iso-date="2024-12-04" /><activity-date type="3" iso-date="2026-09-30" /><contact-info type="1"><organisation><narrative>UK - <iati-activity xml:lang="en" default-currency="GBP" hierarchy="2"><iati-identifier>GB-GOV-1-400503-401</iati-identifier><reporting-org ref="GB-GOV-1" type="10"><narrative>UK - Foreign, Commonwealth Development Office (FCDO)</narrative></reporting-org><title><narrative>Strengthening Human Rights Compliance of the Multinational Security Support  Mission to Haiti
</narrative></title><description type="1"><narrative>The UN-backed Multinational Security Support (MSS) mission to Haiti is supporting the National Police to bring greater security and stabilisation to the country by disrupting and reducing the control of violent gangs. This Programme, implemented by the UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR), will help the MSS achieve its objectives by i) building the capacity of mission personnel to prevent, identify, investigate, report, and follow up on human rights violations, gender-based violence, and sexual exploitation and abuse; ii) advancing human rights protection of Haitian local communities and civil society; and iii) strengthening the capacity of Haitian rule of law entities collaborating with the MSS, such as the police, judiciary and prison administration, to conduct operations in
